resource_policy: At most one GPU occupied by this user, all jobs serial; other users are never stopped
wait_for: Parent pilot C evaluation completed and its GPU process released

diagnostics.stop_policy: Finish the same full round for all three arms; stop once every arm meets both quotas, or after four rounds; retain and report all outcomes
diagnostics.teacher: Frozen same base, adapter disabled, full reference solution visible
diagnostics.grade: Only EOS-completed strictly graded correct/incorrect enter comparison; other outcomes separately counted

interpretation: Long AIME evaluation has a fixed denominator. Adaptive diagnostic sampling is separate and is never used as a benchmark accuracy estimate.
